en-US.longDescription:
Japplis Watch Pro - Clock / Timer / Stopwatch / Alarm / Time Zones / More
Japplis Watch Pro is a set of time utilities. It contains a clock, timer, stopwatch, alarm, calendar, time zone, countdown to date, server time and pomodoro/HIIT. The window can remain always on top and be transparent.
en-US.name: Japplis Watch Pro
